prompt:
Image 1 is the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge of a room. Edit it into the same view of the same room at this time of day: Day. Keep the camera position, framing, lens, walls, doors, windows, furniture, materials and colours exactly as in Image 1; change only the light. Outside every window and doorway, show what that place looks like at Day, with the sky, light and lit windows of that time, never the daylight scene of Image 1 darkened. Inside, light the room as the description says it is lit at that time, with only the lamps it names turned on. The place stays completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette or reflection of a person anywhere. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE. A sleek, modern, contemporary corner office of a high-end architecture and design firm on a high floor, in warm walnut, black leather and white marble. Back wall: floor-to-ceiling glass windows over a daytime city skyline, the main light source, throwing soft daylight from behind towards the camera. A big walnut executive desk stands centred in front of these windows, facing the camera, with a high-backed black leather chair with padded arms behind it. The desktop holds rolled and spread architectural plans, a fan of wood samples, a small brushed-metal abstract figurine and a pour-over coffee station. Left wall: tall walnut shelving with architectural models and material samples, and at its centre a framed black-and-white typographic sign reading "JUST DO IT." In front of the left wall stands the seating area: a tan leather sofa against the shelving, two tan leather armchairs facing each other, and a low white marble coffee table between them. Right wall: a tall walnut door near the front corner, the way in, and a slim console with a plant next to it. Front wall, behind the camera: a pin-up wall of drawings. The open floor between the desk and the right-wall door is a clear space of pale oak flooring. Additional light comes from warm recessed ceiling spots and a black task lamp on the desk.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, a darkened copy of Image 1's daylight, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
